summary: Operationalize the detailed Human-AI collaboration audit into a versioned, late-activation planning snapshot with seven peer OC identities and explicit activation/evidence semantics, while keeping Issue #7 and execution_state as the only mutable planning/execution authorities and preserving the current P2 implementation-admission gate.

requirements.rationale: The operationalization snapshot maps current real-use gaps to existing Requirements without changing Requirement text, criticality or authority. Future activation may re-evaluate whether refinement is needed.

issues_findings.rationale: The detailed audit remains the primary semantic evidence. The new human-readable and machine-readable snapshots preserve seven peer axes, evidence maturity, activation semantics, omissions and restart instructions without creating seven premature work items.

risks.rationale: The operationalization explicitly mitigates drift, authority creep, false completion, state duplication and meta-work risks by separating candidate identity, activation, execution priority, admission and demonstrated capability maturity.

decisions_concepts.rationale: OC identifiers are stable peer identities only, not rank or roadmap. The selected persistence model is audit + versioned immutable operationalization snapshots + existing mutable Planning Owner #7 + late focused activation. No mutable capability registry, new Building Block, Requirement family or workflow engine is introduced.

derived_views.rationale: Refresh only the reconciliation provenance of the generated current-state view; baseline counts and execution authority remain unchanged.

planning_execution_cursor.rationale: Candidate persistence does not manufacture priority. The current P2 preflight remains complete, p2-implementation-admission remains the separate blocked Human gate, and implementation_allowed remains false. Future OC activation requires a fresh current-state work/preflight item.

active_work.rationale: No OC axis is activated as implementation work by this snapshot. P2 implementation also remains not admitted.
